essence: Tended means; Lord tends; release-glory proceeds.
God's five, self's five; delusion the difference.
Expansion sung capable; contraction called wanderer.
Withdrawn grace in oneness; manifesting named veiling.

sections.SUMMARY: By seven-knowerhood, by thirty-six count cultivated: the great Lord tends, release-glory proceeds. Stages doubtless yet made-up, actor-assumed by will. Vast-assumed shining; own-power-tightened impurity in wandering. Incompleteness confessed in impurities' words; Lordship kept all-pervading. Five acts mirrored god-to-self; delusion sole difference. Capable sung of expansion; contracted called wanderer of contraction. Willing glimpse, knowing made-making; keeping and withdrawn-loosing deemed. Withdrawn goddess graces oneness; essence-showing named concealment. Ever-present course known as jewel; unknowing timber-clod.

rasa.dominant: vīra of tended glory; adbhuta of actor-assumed stages; adbhuta of shining-impure; karuṇa-vīra of confessed Lord; vīra of mirrored acts; vīra of named states; adbhuta of willing māyā; karuṇa-adbhuta of graced veiling; adbhuta of jewel-near-yet-clod
rasa.sthayibhava: utsāha at means-tended Lord; vismaya at made-up-yet-doubtless; vismaya at vast yet impure; karuṇotsāha at incomplete-yet-Lord; utsāha at five mirrored; utsāha at sung/called; vismaya at glimpse-willing power; karuṇā-vismaya at grace-in-withdrawal; vismaya at near jewel, far clod
rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is exultation: tended, tending, proceeding. Tending relished. The sthāyibhāva is wonder: doubtless, made-up, actor-assumed. Staging relished. The sthāyibhāva is wonder: assumed vast, impure in wandering. Paradox relished. The sthāyibhāva is compassion-exultation: incomplete confessed, Lord kept. Confession relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: god does, self does. Mirroring relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: expansion sung, contraction called. Naming relished. The sthāyibhāva is wonder: willing glimpse, deemed powers. Willing relished. The sthāyibhāva is compassion-wonder: withdrawn, gracing, veiling. Grace relished. The sthāyibhāva is wonder: jewel ever-near, unknowing cloddish. Nearness relished.
